The case: Chen, former finance chief of hospital, involved in accepting bribes, abusing position to facilitate asset management contract, receiving bribes (20k, 10k actual), receiving 17% equity, receiving return of shares 93k, also misappropriation? He facilitated illegal asset management where funds were misused. Crimes likely: accepting bribes (受贿), abuse of power? Also embezzlement? He didn't personally embezzle hospital funds; the management company misused. He accepted bribes for facilitating contract. Also possibly "职务侵占" (misappropriation of public funds) but he didn't appropriate funds directly. He accepted bribes for his position. Also "非法经营资产管理业务"? Not typical criminal code. Here he didn't divert funds, but the funds were mismanaged by the company; he may be liable for "受贿" and "职务侵占"? The facts: He recommended the company, signed agreement, and got bribes. The funds not returned. He may be charged with "受贿" and "挪用公款"? But he didn't personally divert; he was in charge of supervising but allowed mismanagement. Could be "滥用职权" (abuse of power) but not necessarily. The pattern: In similar case of Chen (first example) they gave "挪用资金". That was about misusing travel agency funds. Here it's about receiving bribes for asset management. So answer likely "受贿". Possibly also "职务侵占" if he misused his position to divert assets. However the assets were entrusted to a third party; he didn't take them. So only "受贿". Also "单位行贿" is for companies bribing officials, not here. So final answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>
